title: Master of Necromancy
description: You can summon the undead to battle
body:
On the fourth day after you defeat an Evoker, a strange visitor appears at your doorstep, hoping to buy food and curiosities.
If you agree to trade with him, he might engage in deeper conversation and even reveal his collection of dubious lore.

You will have a chance to delve into the world of necromancy! A new enchanted book can curse undead creatures, burning them into Essential Saltes – just as Joseph Curwen did. The zombie must be on fire for you to perform this dreadful alchemy, and the book is consumed after a single use.

Zombie servants summoned with Essential Saltes will wander around you. You can right‑click with the salts to mark a distant creature; attacking a target with a sword or bow also marks it. Remember, the casting time is at least three seconds. While sneaking, right‑click to cancel the mark and order your servants to return. Sneak‑right‑click a servant to reclaim the salts.Servants can be armed with swords or axes


Currently you can collect the salts of Zombies, Zombie Villagers, Zombie Horses and Phantoms – there are no immediate plans to expand this list.

If you find the enchanted book too costly, you can also duplicate it with a quill kept by Evokers. Such quills are very rare. Remember to hold the quill in your main hand while copying，holding the book to be copied with non habitual hands,and consume books and pens!

After killing the Evokers, visitors will arrive around 60 minutes later.If you don't want to wait too long,you you can use this command：/summon masterofnecromancy:suspicious_trader.After conducting valuable transactions, the exit interface will refresh the additional transactions

If you encounter any difficulties during use, please feel free to provide feedback to the creator. And, you can find new ways to use props in the mod version update instructions.
